acceptanceCriteria: the staged real docs are judged by doc-router-leaf, doc-links-valid, doc-no-inline-changelog and doc-single-owner
the staged manifest is judged by dep-lockfile, dep-no-vulnerable, dep-no-deprecated and dep-new-needs-reason
repo-hygiene judges staged build output and commit-msg judges the subject
the L3 firing umbrella silent list drops these ten rules
diagnosis: Reproduce: node --test consumer-enforcement-firing-l34.test.ts reports ten stage-probe rules silent. Root cause: the doc, dep, repo-hygiene and conventional-commit enforcers judge fixture marker reports only (SPEC 4.4.1 sample.txt), never the staged real files (SPEC 4.9.2, 4.8.5, 5.11), and commit-msg never judges the message subject (SPEC 4.14.4, 5.11). Probe defects: stage-planning staged no build output, stage-docs had no router, stage-deps pinned latest and supplied no registry snapshot (SPEC 4.8.4).

failing: [consumer] the stage-probe L3 floor rules fire on their gate probes
